issues.what: Large flat pale-blue polygon lying on the road reads as a misplaced puddle/shadow decal: hard-edged, unlit, it doesn't take the reflections around it
issues.where: street.png lower-right road, roughly x950-1360 y750-860; also similar flat blobs in balcony.png centre road (x840-910 y620-640)
issues.fix: Make puddles reflective with soft feathered edges and the same reflection/normal treatment as the wet road, or remove the flat-shaded mesh

issues.what: Road reflection shader produces garish high-frequency rainbow zigzags that look like a glitch/datamosh effect, not wet asphalt. From above it fills half the frame with noise
issues.where: high.png whole lower half; balcony.png road; konbini.png road
issues.fix: Lower the distortion frequency and amplitude, blur the reflections with roughness, cut saturation, and fade the reflections by view angle so top-down views show mostly dark asphalt with soft streaks

issues.what: Small dark box shapes floating or sunk in the road water, read as stray geometry
issues.where: high.png road ~x600-660 y730-770; balcony.png road ~x750-800 y840-890
issues.fix: Remove them or ground them as a clearly readable drain or manhole prop that sits flush with the road

issues.what: Skybridge is untextured, flat grey-lavender panels with no grime, rain streaks, signage or lighting. It is the hero structure and reads as blockout
issues.where: All views; dominant in terrace.png, high.png, balcony.png
issues.fix: Add a material with stains, rust drips and panel seams, a wet sheen, a small fixture light or two, and posters/stickers on the parapet

issues.what: Bridge deck view is barren and flat: a dark empty floor, sparkle dots that read as noise, and identical repeated building facades behind. It looks unfinished, not lonely
issues.fix: Add puddles with reflections on the deck, litter, a broken umbrella or a dead flickering lamp, rain splashes instead of static dots, and vary the backdrop facades

issues.what: Billboard panels on the bridge are plain saturated blue and magenta rectangles with no content
issues.where: konbini.png bridge face, x460-580 and x825-1005
issues.fix: Put faded ad textures or torn posters on them, or remove them

issues.what: Konbini interior is blown out and its shelves are flat primary-coloured blocks; the sign text is clipped to white
issues.fix: Lower the interior emissive and bloom, give the goods some shading and variety, and expose the sign so its text reads

issues.what: Crosswalk stripes look like thick white slabs floating over the reflective road. The reflection shows through and over them, they look z-fought or detached, and they stretch oddly in perspective
issues.where: street.png foreground road; high.png road; balcony.png bottom; konbini.png mid-road ~x900-1010 y650-665
issues.fix: Bake the stripes into the road material as painted decals that share the wet reflection and roughness, flush with the surface and lightly worn

issues.what: The tea terrace on the bridge is not cozy or freshly opened: bare flat-orange low-poly tables and stools sit in a downpour under cold blue light, with no canopy, lanterns, warm light, menu board or greenery
issues.where: terrace.png; also tiny and barely readable in high.png
issues.fix: Add a fabric or noren canopy and string lanterns casting warm pools of light, planters, a counter or tea cart, a chalk menu and a grand-opening banner, give the tables a wood texture, and put steam on the cups

issues.what: Tall black poles rise through the bridge parapet into the sky with nothing on them. They read as canopy posts missing their canopy, or as street poles clipping through
issues.fix: Attach the canopy or lantern strings these posts imply, or remove or shorten them

issues.what: Foreground table clipped by the bottom of the frame, and a stray yellow/black block intrudes at the right edge
issues.where: terrace.png bottom centre and right edge x1590-1672
issues.fix: Move the furniture or camera so nothing is cut at the frame edge, and remove or dress the yellow block

issues.what: Large black slab in the foreground occludes the frame, an untextured rectangle that reads as clipped geometry
issues.fix: Find and texture or hide the mesh (likely an awning or roof edge), or adjust the camera

issues.what: The new tea-shop dressing is all at street level. From balcony and street the bridge terrace is invisible, so 'rooftop tea terrace on the bridge' does not read from most views
issues.fix: Make the bridge terrace visible from below: lanterns strung along the parapet, a warm glow spilling over the edge, a banner hung on the bridge face

issues.what: The stage 1 konbini view is nearly identical to stage 0; the transformation barely registers
issues.fix: Carry the opening into this view with warm lanterns on the bridge, a banner over the poster panels and less rain or a lighter grade

issues.what: Rain streaks are very dense and bright in the foreground and veil the new cozy details
issues.fix: Thin the near-camera rain and lower its brightness for stage 1, or soften it to drizzle so the warmth comes through

verdict: Strong base mood: neon-lit night, wet streets and layered skyline give real atmosphere, and stage 0 street/balcony are close to cinematic. But the hero skybridge is untextured blockout, the reflection shader turns into psychedelic glitch noise from any elevated view, and there are stray floating boxes and flat decal blobs. Stage 1's street-level tea shop is a genuine improvement, but the actual rooftop terrace is bare low-poly furniture in cold rain with bare poles. It is neither cozy nor freshly opened, and floating crosswalk slabs were added. Not yet a finished place.
